analyst_view.overall: Early view: Dortmund are second, level on 21 points with Bayern and unbeaten in the league under Niko Kovac, though three of their last five were draws and Serhou Guirassy has a thigh strain with no return date given. Augsburg under Manuel Baum have lost three of their last four, most recently 5-2 at Leipzig, and their games keep being open: they scored at least twice in each of their first six matches but leak goals late.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals. I lean a little higher: Augsburg's matches have been wild this season (4-3 at Elversberg, 5-2 at Leipzig) and they concede late, while they also keep scoring. If Guirassy is still out Dortmund are less sharp up front, which is the main thing that could pull this down.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.9 corners. Dortmund should have most of the ball at home against a side in the bottom half, which fits the expected split. Nothing I found points clearly either way.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.8 cards. Dortmund's game against Elversberg brought only three bookings, and the referee is not known yet. I see no reason to move away from the site's figure this early.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.7 shots. Dortmund at home plus an Augsburg side that attacks even when behind should keep the count high, which the model already expects. Dortmund looked short of ideas in the first half against Elversberg without Guirassy, so I do not go above it.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10 shots on target. Augsburg's leaky defence should give Dortmund chances, and Felix Nmecha has been shooting well from distance. Guirassy's fitness is the key check in the final week.
